question: As part of its communication entitled ‘A modernised Cohesion policy: The mid-term review’, the Commission stated that it ‘will launch a consultation on the development of a Strategy for Islands’. 1.
Can the Commission provide an update on the time frame for this initiative?
Can the Commission confirm the strategy will take account of the specificities and challenges facing small inhabited islands (with fewer than 5 000 people), such as those of Ireland’s coast?
answer: The Commission will launch a consultation to prepare an EU-wide strategy covering islands and coastal communities by early 2026. The strategy, foreseen in the 2026 Commission Work Programme, will set out a framework to better address the needs of EU islands, taking into account their specific characteristics. The exact scope will be clarified following the consultation.
